import os, re, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta

LOG_DIR = "/app/logs"
TODAY = date(2025, 8, 12)
SEVS = ["ERROR", "WARNING", "INFO"]

# period name -> predicate on date
periods = {
    "today":        lambda d: d == TODAY,
    "last_7_days":  lambda d: (TODAY - timedelta(days=6)) <= d <= TODAY,   # 2025-08-06..12
    "last_30_days": lambda d: (TODAY - timedelta(days=29)) <= d <= TODAY,  # 2025-07-14..12
    "month_to_date":lambda d: (TODAY.year, TODAY.month, 1) <= (d.year, d.month, d.day) <= (TODAY.year, TODAY.month, TODAY.day),
    "total":        lambda d: True,
}

counts = {p: {s: 0 for s in SEVS} for p in periods}
line_re = re.compile(r'^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \[(\w+)\]')

files = sorted(os.listdir(LOG_DIR))
for fn in files:
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})_(.+)\.log$', fn)
    assert m, f"bad filename: {fn}"
    fdate = date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)))
    with open(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, fn), "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            lm = line_re.match(line)
            if not lm:
                continue
            sev = lm.group(2)
            if sev not in SEVS:
                continue
            for p, pred in periods.items():
                if pred(fdate):
                    counts[p][sev] += 1

with open("/app/summary.csv", "w", newline="") as out:
    w = csv.writer(out)
    w.writerow(["period", "severity", "count"])
    for p in ["today", "last_7_days", "last_30_days", "month_to_date", "total"]:
        for s in SEVS:
            w.writerow([p, s, counts[p][s]])

print("Done.")
for p in ["today", "last_7_days", "last_30_days", "month_to_date", "total"]:
    print(p, counts[p])
EOF
